notes.title: 🎃👻 Happy Halloween Event 🎃👻
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

In the spirit of the Halloween season, Skoory Rush received a spooky update with new backgrounds and new music soundtrack. 

It's available to play from 23rd of October to 5th November.

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: New release
notes.notes:
Hello Skoory Fans!

We’re excited to announce that the our latest game, Poker Train, is now free to play on Steam!

Poker Train combines the strategy of video poker with relaxing, idle gameplay and incremental stat-building elements. Perfect for both poker enthusiasts and casual gamers alike. Download the game today and start your journey!
